title: Sequential circuit state
statement: For a sequential Boolean circuit $M$ with $n$ inputs and $r$ registers, and an input assignment $x\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, define its state $s_t\colon\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ at each time $t\in\mathbb{N}$ recursively: $s_0$ is the initial register state, and $s_{t+1}(j)$ is the value at the next-value index specified for register $j$ when the combinational circuit is evaluated on the input assignment followed by $s_t$, with any index outside the resulting value list assigned value false.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a Boolean assignment to the $n$ inputs
